name: Shiprocket Limited
summary: Shiprocket Ltd. engages in providing an API-led technology platform designed to enable e-commerce transactions for India’s MSMEs and large retailers. The firm offers simplified logistics, checkouts, payments, fulfillment, and cross-border trade, enabling merchants to sell online and offline. It operates through the Core and Emerging Business segments. The Core Business segment refers to the domestic shipping platform providing merchants with access to logistics services to deliver goods to end consumers within India and shipping apps, which are value-added software utilities that serve to enhance merchants’ shipping transactions. The Emerging Business segment offers a range of additional tools and platforms that merchants can leverage independently, such as the cross-border platform, checkout platform, marketing solutions, hyperlocal deliveries through Shiprocket Quick, and capital solutions. The company was founded by Saahil Goel, Gautam Kapoor, Akshay Ghulati, and Vishesh Khurana on September 28, 2011 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.
